_about: The copy table for the parfast desktop GUI. ONE source for both apps
(PLAN-PARFAST-GUI-2026-09-12 section 5.7). Owned by chip B; chip C reads it and
proposes additions by handoff, never by editing.
Copy rules, enforced by Tools/generate.py --check and not only remembered:
- no em-dash (U+2014) and no en-dash (U+2013) as punctuation; use a spaced hyphen
- the word 'streaming' never appears in user-facing copy
- sentence case for buttons and labels, on BOTH platforms (Fluent guidance agrees)
- sizes in binary units with thousands separators; the app formats, the table only
carries the {placeholder}, so a locale can move it
A value with {placeholders} generates a function taking one String per placeholder,
in first-appearance order, so a missing argument is a compile error rather than a
A value may be an OBJECT of platform keys instead of a string: {"mac": ..., "windows": ...}.
Five strings name a platform's own file manager or machine, and copy that is wrong
on the screen is worse than copy that is merely untranslated. A generator picks its
own platform and MUST refuse a split that does not carry its key.
A split whose arm is EMPTY means the line does not apply on that platform; the app
omits it rather than rendering a blank. One key must carry ONE fact - two lanes nearly
lost a sentence to settings.integration.context_note holding two.
